---
title: "Methods"
description: "Planned methods and stewardship documentation for the saRNA Database."
---

The sections below reserve the structure for the methods documentation that will accompany the first validated release.

## Literature-search strategy

The literature review identifies peer-reviewed publications and patents as relevant source types.

## Inclusion and exclusion criteria

The final criteria will specify which saRNA, antigene RNA, promoter-targeting, and transcript-targeting reports qualify for inclusion. 

## Sequence extraction

The draft project scope includes guide and passenger strands, duplex length, terminal overhangs, reported chemical modifications, and the target sequence or target region when reported. 

## Experimental-condition extraction

Planned fields include species, cell line or tissue model, concentration, delivery or transfection vehicle, treatment timing, assay timing, and relevant formulation details.

## Outcome extraction

The database is intended to preserve author-reported activity assessments and their readout context.

## Corrections

Users will be able to report suspected errors, missing publications, sequence discrepancies, and metadata corrections through the project contact channel. Accepted corrections will be documented and incorporated into a later version rather than silently overwriting a released record.
